title: Activation bias stabilizer pipeline and runtime fallback integration for INT8 deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: build an end-to-end activation-aware INT8 calibration pipeline that stabilizes per-layer bias drift (bias-stabilizer), produces deployable quant profiles, and wires a lightweight runtime fallback path to FP16 microkernels for out-of-distribution activation events. This ticket covers: (1) a calibration stage that collects trace statistics from representative production traffic and a synthetic corpus, (2) a bias-stabilization transform (post-smoothquant pass) that corrects per-channel residuals discovered during validation, (3) a packaging/export format for quant profiles that encodes runlevel thresholds, and (4) runtime kernel routing and a graceful fallback policy when activations exceed calibrated thresholds. The design should prioritize minimal latency regression, reproducible accuracy evaluation, and CI gating to prevent bad rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline (qs-calib) runs on a 10k-sample representative trace and outputs quant profile JSON with per-layer bias_correction and runlevel_threshold fields
End-to-end accuracy regression <= 0.6% absolute on our chat generation eval set compared to FP16 baseline after bias-stabilizer pass
Runtime can detect activation overflow at token time and route single requests to FP16 microkernel within 3ms extra p95 latency compared to INT8 path
CI quant-e2e job validates candidate profile on a holdout eval set and blocks merges if accuracy or latency thresholds are violated
Operator docs and rollout checklist published in Confluence with rollback commands and metric dashboards links
work_notes: 2025-01-18: Kickoff — scoped to decoder-style transformer families; exclude encoder-only models for this iteration.
2025-01-24: Prototype qs-calib that collects per-tensor min/max, mean, variance, and activation skew metrics from a streaming trace exporter (traffic-sample v2).

2025-02-02: Implemented bias-stabilizer transform (bias-corrector) that computes a per-channel additive correction after SmoothQuant scaling to re-center activations; initial tests show reduced layerwise MSE by ~18% on GPT-like small model.

2025-02-11: Packaging format agreed: quant profile JSON contains version, model_fingerprint, per_layer entries with scale, zero_point, bias_correction, runlevel_thresholds, and ci_metadata. Added schema v1.0 to repo.

2025-02-18: Runtime shim implemented in inference runtime: lightweight check at KV-cache emit points to compare activation magnitude vs runlevel_threshold and trigger an alternate microkernel path. Built FP16 microkernel wrapper for small-batch failover.
2025-02-21: Integration tests flaky due to differing tokenization between trace and eval harness; fixed normalization pipeline (qs-calib now uses tokenizer v3).
2025-02-24: Perf microbenchmarks: INT8 path median latency unchanged, p95 increases by 6% in worst-case when fallback triggers; optimization planned to reduce context switch overhead.

2025-03-01: First CI run of quant-e2e blocked due to regression on one prompt group (long-form summarization). Identified layer 17 residual bias spike; adjusted bias_correction clamp and re-ran, regression reduced below threshold.
review_feedback: PM (Rosa Nguyen) 2025-01-25: Prioritize stability for production workloads; ensure rollback is automated via rollout policy.
Platform Eng (Diego Torres) 2025-02-05: Ensure quant profile schema includes model_fingerprint and git_commit for traceability. Add validation to reject profiles without matching runtime ABI.
Perf Lead (Hannah Kim) 2025-02-19: Fallback overhead must be measured at token granularity; add microbench harness that isolates branch misprediction and context switch costs.
test_results_summary: Representative trace (10k samples): bias-stabilizer reduced per-layer residual mean by median 12% (p50) and 9% (p95)
Holdout eval (3k prompts): generation BLEU-like metric delta vs FP16 = -0.45% absolute after correction
Fallback correctness: injected OOD activations (scale x8) correctly routed to FP16 in 100% of attempts in a synthetic harness
CI job quant-e2e: initial failure rate 1/6 candidates due to summarization prompt group; fixed by clamping bias_correction to [-0.03, 0.03] per-channel
